brief.headline: Our ₹7775 annual spend is too small to push price — shift to faster payment (15 days) to free up ₹320 cash for us, and line up Huhtamaki or Constantia as a second source.

priceAsk.summary: Hold price or ask for a small token cut — our spend is tiny and the current price sits at the top of the fair band.
priceAsk.basis: Market asks for pharma/ORS sachet laminate run ₹205–305/kg; we're already in the fair range (top end) so a big cut isn't realistic on ₹7775 spend.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 30 days to 15 days after receipt — offer to pay faster in exchange for smooth supply and consistent quality.

brief.financialLeverage: Silk Polypack publishes no financials, so we can't see their cash position or how much profit they make. Our ₹7775 annual spend is very small — we're not a major customer, which limits how hard we can push on price. The smart play is to use faster payment as our bargaining chip (they likely value cash speed when business is private and small) and to quietly develop a second source so we're not stuck if supply wobbles.

evidence.point: Our total annual spend with them is tiny
Market asking price for pharma/ORS sachet laminate sits in a fair band
The verdict on market price is we're already fair
Paying 15 days faster frees up this much cash for us

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexible-packaging converter already supplying FDC in tiny volumes — a proven, scalable second source for laminate sachets (revenue ₹2755.75 Cr).

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Part of the global Constantia group, does pharma blister and sachet laminates — strong second-source fit (revenue ₹222.04 Cr).

risks: Our spend is so small (₹7775) that pushing too hard on price may not be worth their effort — they could just walk away.
Silk Polypack's finances aren't public, so we're flying blind on whether they're stable or stretched — watch for any supply hiccups as an early warning.
We have no internal price benchmark (no average or best price from other vendors) — rely on the market ask band to stay grounded.
The alternate converters (Huhtamaki, Constantia) are leads to qualify — verify their laminate specs and pricing before treating them as live backups.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to tighten payment to 15 days to help your cash flow — in return, we need rock-solid supply and want to talk through how we can grow this ₹7775 relationship together.
